```yaml
name: PR CI

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, edited]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Autofix formatting and lint
        uses: autofix-ci/action@635ffb0c9798bd160680f18fd73371e355b85f27
        with:
          fail-fast: true
          commit-message: "chore: autofix formatting and lint"
          comment: "Autofix applied"

      - name: Run lint
        run: npm run lint

      - name: Run type-check
        run: npm run type-check

      - name: Build
        run: npm run build

      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test -- --coverage

      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/test-results-action@v1
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          directory: ./coverage

      - name: Run npm audit
        run: npm audit --audit-level=high

      - name: PostHog tracking
        uses: PostHog/posthog-github-action@eea1405eeb2d1d2259f0ee0b44d7b152869e6840
        with:
          posthog-token: ${{ secrets.POSTHOG_TOKEN }}
          event: "ci:pr"
          properties: '{"branch":"${{ github.ref }}","workflow":"${{ github.workflow }}"}'
          capture-run-duration: true
          capture-job-durations: true
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          runner: ${{ runner.name }}
          status-job: ${{ job.status }}
```
